name: Yanagida Sayuki
source:
Hometown: Narumi
Likes: Speaking to one person at a time
Dislikes: Early mornings
Favorite things: PC and tabletop games

A first-year girl and [url=https://vndb.org/c30944]Sakurako's[/url] roommate. A taciturn who is always looking down and who speaks quietly. However, she has a very poisonous tongue. Sayuki has a tendency to stay at her room for a long time like a hikikomori whenever she studies or is playing games by herself. Her favorite games include one-person Monopoly and other games which she can play by herself.
